backend/main.mo: Main Motoko actor for the Skyllx app implementing user profile management, study plan generation, and task completion tracking with role-based access control via AccessControl and MixinAuthorization mixins.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report documenting two implemented features: making ReadinessScoreRing always visible with silent error fallback, and updating useGetReadinessScore to resolve errors as 0 instead of propagating error state.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: JSON map of all frontend source files to short summaries, serving as a reference index for the project's frontend component and page structure.
frontend/index.css: Root CSS file importing Tailwind layers and defining OKLCH-based CSS custom properties for light and dark theme color tokens including background, foreground, chart, and sidebar variables.
frontend/index.html: Minimal HTML entry point for the Skyllx Vite/React app, mounting the React root div and loading the main TSX module.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Defines the TanStack Router route tree with routes for dashboard, onboarding, study plan, and skill gap pages, wrapping main pages in AppLayout and exporting the RouterProvider.
frontend/src/components/dashboard/Naviga: Reusable card component that renders a TanStack Router Link with an icon, title, description, and optional stat display, styled with neon hover effects.
frontend/src/components/dashboard/Readin: SVG circular progress ring that always renders using useGetReadinessScore, defaulting to 0 on error or undefined, showing a skeleton during loading and applying red/amber/green color thresholds.
frontend/src/components/dashboard/TodayT: Renders a list of today's tasks with checkboxes that trigger backend completion mutations, skill badges, and duration display, with an empty state when all tasks are done.
frontend/src/components/dashboard/Weekly: Displays a labeled progress bar showing weekly task completion count and percentage, calculated from completed and total task props.
frontend/src/components/layout/AppLayout: Defines the main app shell with a sticky header, desktop and mobile navigation links (Dashboard, Study Plan, Skill Gap), an Outlet for child routes, and a footer.
frontend/src/components/onboarding/JobRo: Onboarding step component that renders a dropdown for selecting a target job role from a predefined list, with a confirmation message on selection.
frontend/src/components/onboarding/Skill: Onboarding step that lets users add and remove current skills via text input or quick-add suggestions, storing them as Skill objects.
frontend/src/components/onboarding/StepI: Displays a horizontal multi-step progress indicator with numbered circles, checkmarks for completed steps, connecting lines, and step labels.
frontend/src/components/onboarding/Study: Onboarding step for entering weekly study hours via a number input or preset quick-select buttons, with a summary message based on the chosen value.
frontend/src/components/skillgap/Missing: Renders a list of missing skills with per-skill add buttons, tracking loading and added states, and shows a success message when no gaps exist.
frontend/src/components/skillgap/SkillBa: Small badge component that displays a skill name styled green for matched or red for unmatched, with an optional add button for unmatched skills.
frontend/src/components/studyplan/TaskIt: Renders a single study task with a checkbox, title, description, associated skill badge, and duration, supporting completion toggling and a pending state.
frontend/src/components/studyplan/WeekAc: Accordion component for a weekly study module that shows week number, task completion count, a progress bar, and expands to list individual TaskItem components.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Creates and caches an ICP backend actor using React Query, supporting both anonymous and authenticated (Internet Identity) usage, and invalidates dependent queries when the actor changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Provides an Internet Identity authentication context and hook, managing login/logout state via AuthClient and exposing identity, login status, and helper flags to child components.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Defines React Query hooks for fetching and mutating backend data (profile, study plan, readiness score, skill gaps), with optimistic updates for task completion.
frontend/src/index.css: Global stylesheet that imports fonts, sets up Tailwind, and defines CSS custom properties for a dark-first design system including neon accent colors and surface tokens.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Application entry point that mounts the React app with QueryClientProvider and InternetIdentityProvider wrappers around the root App component.
frontend/src/pages/DashboardPage.tsx: Dashboard page that displays the user's readiness score, today's tasks, weekly progress, and navigation cards, redirecting to onboarding if no profile exists.
frontend/src/pages/OnboardingPage.tsx: Multi-step onboarding page that collects job role, skills, and study hours, then creates a user profile and generates a default study plan before navigating to the dashboard.
frontend/src/pages/SkillGapPage.tsx: Displays the skill gap analysis page showing the user's current skills, missing skills, and job readiness score ring, with the ability to add missing skills to their profile.
frontend/src/pages/StudyPlanPage.tsx: Renders the study plan page with a weekly accordion layout, overall completion progress bar, and task completion toggling via the backend.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Provides utility functions for reading URL query parameters (including hash-based routing), persisting them to sessionStorage, and cleaning sensitive params from the URL.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind CSS configuration defining the dark-themed design system with custom colors (neon green, charcoal, surface), fonts, border radii, neon box shadows, and accordion animations.
project_state.json: Tracks the project's current state including version, feature list, known issues (e.g., readiness score not visible), and a fix-request flag for the AI-powered study planner app.
